text:
emma: Heads-up — rate card v2.4 just merged to prod. Quick question: does the new partner discount bucket alter reseller resale margins or signer routing? Need to tell a reseller with an active POC tonight.

josh-dealdesk: Short answer: it changes how discounts are applied at quote-time, but existing committed SKUs should remain on the old slab for 90 days (grace window). Resellers get the new partner bucket by default for new quotes.

emma: Ok thanks. Who owns the note to include in the quote template and signer flow? Reseller wants invoices to show the partner discount line item.

michael-legal: @emma we need to be careful with resale language — our contract allows partners to resell but prohibits changing MRR attribution. Billing will need the partner tag in invoice metadata. I can approve wording: "Partner discount applied per ratecard v2.4".

sarah-ops: For signer routing: signing flow won't change. But our contract-signing app reads SKU tags to decide CC routing. If you need invoices to show partner line, make sure quoting maps partner_tag -> invoice_tag.

oliver-quoting: I can update the quoting mapping. Quick snippet for the mapping change: 
``` 
quote_to_invoice_tags = { 
  "partner_discount": "partner_line", 
  "commit_credit": "commit_line" 
} 
```
I'll push to staging tonight.

liam-cs: FYI customer on the POC asked for retroactive credit if they sign within 7 days — is that allowed?

josh-dealdesk: Retroactive credits only if deal desk approves an exception. Standard policy: no retroactive price changes to already invoiced usage. We can do a one-time credit note.

michael-legal: Also need to ensure resellers don't republish our list prices. Add this clause: "Resellers may not advertise RTV/discounted unit prices as Redwood list prices."

emma: Great — sounds like action items: (1) @oliver update quoting->invoice tag mapping (2) @josh add partner discount line to quote template + exception path (3) @michael finalize reseller clause (4) @sarah confirm signer routing no-ops. I'll send a short note to partners after we have the quote template.

billing-bot: Billing note: commit slab effective date = 2026-04-01. New partner_bucket code = PBKT-2026-04. Use when creating invoice templates to enable line-item.

sarah-ops: Confirmed no signer flow changes. Will monitor for any routing regressions after oliver's mapping change.

josh-dealdesk: I'll draft the quote template now and post link to staging: https://staging.redwood/quotes/partner-v2.4 (will add test signer flow) :white_check_mark:

oliver-quoting: pushed mapping to staging, tagging release as staging/quote-mapping-PBKT.

emma: Thanks team. I'll hold messaging to reseller until we confirm quote template + billing tag are live. :thumbsup:
